// Method and sources

Errors: Walmart QC reports for Outputs 1 to 4 (items marked Error, minus the rebuttals Walmart accepted) plus 32 corrections to Output 4 from a second Walmart review on 20 Nov. Scores are Walmart's own QC figures; Output 4's line also shows the rate once those 32 are counted.

Verdicts: each item was read against Walmart's Books definitions doc (PT_Classification_Definitions_Books_final.docx). Our miss: our label breaks a clear SOP rule. Walmart vs its SOP: our label is what the SOP says and Walmart's correction is not. SOP unclear: the SOP does not settle it, or the listing is too thin to tell. This is our reading of the SOP, made item by item from the listing text; it has not been confirmed with Walmart.

Step A and Step B: Step A Performance App export of 19 Nov, batches 75-1 and 75-2. "Unchanged through Step B" also covers items Step B did not review.
